verdict.rationale: The only relevant evidence is a single docs mention that named agents have "routines the daemon fires" plus notifications. This suggests some automatic triggering of agent work, but nothing shows user-defined rules or which events can fire them. missing for 10: documented rule/trigger definition syntax, list of supported event types (e.g., file, app, webhook or schedule events), configurable conditions-to-actions mapping, and any hands-on or independent corroboration.
